descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Intern - Direct Procurement Contract type: Contract of mandate (umowa zlecenie) for 12 months Availability: 5 days per week, 25 - 40 hours per week Place of work: Warsaw Office or Remote Join our procurement team as an operational and administrative support specialist! This is an ideal opportunity for someone starting their career to learn procurement processes from the inside, gain experience working in SAP , and participate in the department's digital transformation. You will support us in ensuring supply continuity and building professional relationships with our suppliers. The Opportunity: Operational and Systems Support:
• SAP Order Management: Support in creating and processing orders, as well as monitoring delivery deadlines to clients.
• Vendor Database Management: Setting up new vendors and unblocking existing accounts in the system.
• Material Data Administration: Creating new material indexes in the system and performing regular price list updates. P rocess and Quality Support:
• Contractor Verification: Conducting supplier Due Diligence to secure current business operations and updating the Preferred Supplier List (LPD) .
• Documentation Oversight: Managing specialized documentation related to medical devices ( IVD/MD ).
• Fulfilment Monitoring: Supervising the status of order fulfillment and informing partners about delivery schedules. Administrative Tasks and Innovation:
• Contract Workflow and Archiving: Managing the signing process and circulation of documents with suppliers, and archiving documents within systems ( MyBuy ).
• Communication and AI: Maintaining the Procurement Intranet site and providing substantive oversight of materials for the AI assistant . Who you are:
• You own a University Degree or you are still studying
• You are meticulous and accurate when working with data and IT systems.
• You have strong time management skills and the ability to prioritize tasks.
• You have great communication skills and a desire to work in a dynamic, modern environment.
• You are proficient in Polish & English What you get:
• Flexibility: A contract of mandate ( umowa zlecenie ) that can easily be adjusted to your university schedule.
• Modern Toolkit: Opportunity to learn SAP and MyBuy tools within international structures.
• Exposure to Innovation: The chance to co-create solutions based on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in procurement.
• Expert Development: Working within a team of "team players" who focus on knowledge sharing and substantive support. If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it. Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche first-hand? Check out our blog! https://careers.roche.com/global/en/we-are-roche The controller of your personal data is Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o., ul. Domaniewska 28, 02-672 Warsaw. The data is processed for the purpose of recruitment. You have the right to access data, rectify it, delete it, limit processing, transfer it and - if processing is based on your consent - withdraw this consent at any time. Contact the Data Protection Officer at: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. More information on the principles of processing your personal data by Roche at the link: https://www.roche.pl/privacy-policy-recruitment-dia-en. Roche Diagnostics sp. z o.o. operates in full compliance with the law and does not tolerate any violations. Roche Diagnostics sp. z o.o. has implemented a Procedure for Reporting Violations of Law.
